title: dispatch-record/1
description: One record per dispatch attempt from the harness adapter (DESIGN.md 3, 'Harness adapter contract'). Sibling of decision-record/1 sharing the identity fields; the shared identity closes the attribution gap between the two record streams.
$comment: DESIGN.md 4 'dispatch-record/1'. The $id host is a placeholder (DESIGN.md 'Open questions'). One dispatch record per attempt; declared retries emit one record per attempt with a fresh attempt ordinal. outcome-shaped keys are rejected by the validation-time reject list in framework/records.py (reconciler-only).

action_id.$comment: DESIGN.md 5: opaque, stable per spec action, generated by the adapter; never null in a dispatch record.

attempt.$comment: DESIGN.md 4: fresh ordinal per attempt; default 0.

carrier_used.$comment: DESIGN.md 5: which carrier the ids travelled on for this attempt.

result.$comment: DESIGN.md 4: 'result or error', exactly one present (oneOf below). The result body is harness-defined (per-attempt terminal status); the framework never re-derives outcomes from it.

fail_mode.$comment: DESIGN.md 4 decision-record error vocabulary reused: whether the dispatch failure left the action open or closed.

ids.$comment: DESIGN.md 4 and 5: vendor-native request/session ids; debugging only.
